departures.explainerDesktop: Overnight train both ways — Sat 10:30pm out, Mon 5:30am back, so no leave from school or office. Ex Vadodara, boarding also at Ahmedabad and Surat. Price includes train, cab, breakfast, lunch, trek leader, forest entry and first aid.

why.label: Why we exist
why.heading: We run on no profit, no loss.
why.p1: Every fee is costed at what the camp actually costs — food, transport, guides, permits, insurance. Whatever is left at the end of a season doesn't go to owners, because there are none. It goes into tree plantation around Pavagadh, rainwater harvesting in Bakor, and livelihood work with the families in Dhobi village who host our Himalayan camps.
why.p2: Our accounts are filed as a registered public trust and shared with any parent who asks for them.
